leaves.name: neronSchemeModelExistsDVR
leaves.doc: Bosch-Lutkebohmert-Raynaud, Neron models (1990), 1.4 Thm 3 with 1.2 Def 1, over an arbitrary discrete valuation ring (locator UNVERIFIED). The bundles have it only over the rings of integers of number fields (neronSchemeExtensionExists).
leaves.source: BLR 1.4 Thm 3 over any DVR (locator UNVERIFIED); needed for r7a over every field, not for its one live consumer (number fields)

leaves.name: torsionInjectsSpecialFibre
leaves.doc: GLUE (nos-converse): inertia-fixed m-torsion of A(Kbar), m prime to p, injects into the m-torsion kbar-points of the geometric special fibre of a Neron model (Neron property over O^sh, [m] etale on smooth group schemes, BLR 7.3/2).

leaves.name: dimensionRelation
leaves.doc: GLUE (nos-converse): for a Neron model whose geometric special fibre has semi-abelian identity component (torus rank r, abelian quotient B), dim B + r = dim A.
leaves.source: fibre dimension of smooth group schemes (groupSchemeEquidim, infra-smooth-dim) and of U -> B with fibres G_m^r

leaves.name: abelianReductionGood
leaves.doc: Neron model whose geometric special fibre has abelian identity component => good reduction (Serre-Tate 1968 sections 1-2; BLR 7.4; EGA IV 15.7.10-type properness criterion; locators UNVERIFIED).
